# Vendored Validator Schemas

`odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json` is the Open Data Contract Standard v3.1.0 JSON Schema from
<https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/blob/v3.1.0/schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json>.
It is distributed by the upstream project under Apache License 2.0. The repository gate pins its
SHA-256 digest in `src/llb/artifacts/constants.py`; updating it requires an explicit ODCS version
and digest change.
